title: National Counter Terrorism Authority Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: National Counter Terrorism Authority Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 2020
ACT XIV OF 2020
NATIONAL COUNTER TERRORISM AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the National Counter
Terrorism Authority Act, 2013
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
21st March, 2020]
No.
F. 22(30)/2019-Legis, dated 20.3.2020.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on the 18th March, 2020 is hereby Published for general
information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the National Counter Terrorism Authority Act,
2013 (XIX of 2013) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act shall be called the National Counter Terrorism Authority (Amendment) Act,
2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

WHEREAS

2013 (XIX of 2013) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
3. Substitution
of section 5, Act XIX of 2013.---In
the said Act, for section 5, the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"5.
Board of Governors.---(1) The
Authority shall have a Board of Governors comprising,-
(a)
Minister In-charge of
Interior Division
Chairman
(b)
Secretary, Interior
Division
Member
(c)
Secretary, Defence
Division
Member
(d)
Secretary, Law and
Justice Division
Member
(e)
Secretary, Finance
Division
Member
(f)
One member from the
opposition and one member from Treasury benches respectively in the Senate of
Pakistan to be nominated by the Chairman Senate;
Members
(g)
One member from the
opposition and one member from Treasury benches respectively in the National
Assembly to be nominated by the Speaker, National Assembly;
Members
(h)
Director General,
Intelligence Bureau
Member
(i)
Director General,
Federal Investigation Agency
Member
(j)
Director General (CT),
Inter-Services-Intelligence
Member
(k)
Representative of
Directorate General, Military Intelligence (Not less than DG)
Member
(l)
National Coordinator
of the Authority
Member
(m)
Home Secretaries of
the Provinces of Sindh, Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan,
Gilgit-Baltistan and State of Azad Jammu and Kashmir and Chief Commissioner,
Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT)
Members
(n)
Inspectors General of
Police of Provinces of Sindh, Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan,
Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT), Gilgit-Baltistan and State of Azad Jammu
and Kashmir.
Members
(2) The
National Coordinator of the Authority shall act as the Secretary to the Board.
(3) The
Board may invite any person to the meeting on special invitation."
